Landing.heroTitle: The Waze and Wolt of photography locations.
Landing.heroSubtitle: Discover, filter, and navigate to vetted photography locations. Real-time updates, accessibility info, and a community-curated map of spots that are actually worth your time.
Landing.feature1Body: Toggle between an interactive map and rich list cards with rating, distance, and accessibility at a glance.
Landing.feature2Body: See bloom timing, construction warnings, and access changes posted by photographers on the ground.
Landing.feature3Body: Contribute approved locations, photos, and updates to earn points. Spend them to reveal exclusive premium spots.
